218040.description:
Eat Or Die!

The first prince of the kingdom of Farune, Mars, is only twelve years old, yet he lives in fear of assassination. In order to avoid the deadly poison in nearly all of his meals, he slips out of the castle into the nearby monster-infested forest, where, battling monsters and his own hunger, he has to hunt for his meals in order to stave off starvation. Then, one night, as he’s searching for his next bite of monster meat, a red-haired woman shouldering a greatsword appears before him and says to him, “You have promise. Become my apprentice.” How is he supposed to tell her that this must be some sort of mistake? But there’s a secret that only she knows, and that he’s stumbled upon: eating monsters makes you stronger! With her training and his newfound power, Mars will finally overcome all those pesky assassination attempts. However, that doesn’t end things; no, it’s only the beginning of a nationwide—even continent-spanning—series of wars and plots with him right in the middle!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)
synonyms: How I Became King by Eating Monsters

Or will it be someone else...?

218439.description:
When Kanako accidentally applies to work at an assassination agency, the timid office worker discovers that she has a knack for bumping people off. Will she ever earn the respect of Sakurai, her prickly and kinda hot co-worker–and why is she still having silly workplace problems when she’s employed with hitmen?! This full-color manga is dangerously funny!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

218025.description:
Navier devoted her life to ruling the Eastern Empire beside her husband and childhood friend, Sovieshu. But when he falls for his concubine and demands a divorce, Navier shocks the empire with her response. She accepts and requests a remarriage to Heinrey, a prince of the Western Empire. Now, the fallen empress fights to seize back her future and turn the tables on those who cast her aside!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

218315.description:
After missing a week of school right at the start of the new school year due to a mysterious fever, and trying to hide his isolation behind a reading addict persona, Yuuhi Takamiya was in a state of grief! His cry of sorrow "I want friends!" was met with a response from Nano, an alien from the Pokoton planet. She came from outer space to conduct some (aggressive) marketing, and... thanks to her demo product, Yuuhi's high school life will never be the same. A cute and exciting slapstick comedy on a cosmic scale is about to begin!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

218679.description:
The Emotion Kingdom is getting ready for its biggest musical celebration of the year: the Emotion Festival!

Just as the festival is about to begin, the legendary Legend Teeniepings set to headline the event suddenly disappear, putting the whole festival in jeopardy.

Princess Romi teams up with a new group of Royal Teeniepings to find them and save the festival!
